description: This is an HTML file that serves as a webpage for the COBOL mode in CodeMirror, a JavaScript code editor component. It contains HTML structure, CSS styles, JavaScript initialization code for the editor, and the sample COBOL source code displayed within a textarea.

methods.name: selectTheme
methods.description: Updates the CodeMirror theme based on user selection from dropdown.

methods.name: selectFontsize
methods.description: Changes the font size of the CodeMirror editor.

methods.name: selectReadOnly
methods.description: Toggles the read-only mode of the editor.

methods.name: tabToIndentSpace
methods.description: Sets the Tab key behavior to insert spaces.
